title: `nvs lsp-test` writes each case's files into the system temp directory.
text: `Materialised::write` creates its directory under `std::env::temp_dir()`. It is the runner, not test code, so the guard `no_test_code_writes_into_the_system_temp_dir` in `crates/nvs-repo/tests/scratch.rs` does not read it. Whether it moves under `target/` like test scratch is the user's call: `lsp-test` is a command of the `nvs` binary, which can run where there is no `target/`.
